findings.sourceReading: Jessica playfully threatens a liar with swallowing a thousand needles while making Shannon promise they will get lovers together. The exact punishment is hari senbon nomasu.
findings.alternative: Porcupinefish may be a playful response to the harisenbon sound, but the source explicitly has a thousand needles and swallowing, not eating a fish. The adaptation retains a playful oath but replaces its concrete image and verbal content.

findings.sourceReading: After Jessica says men and women have quite different values, Mammon emphatically agrees: they differ, they differ, they are completely different. She illustrates that difference with girls dreaming and boys being thoughtless.
findings.alternative: Chigaimasu can reject a statement when used alone. Here its referent is the immediately preceding claim that values differ, and the explanatory contrast elaborates that claim rather than refuting it. No, that is not it ... all wrong makes agreement into correction.

MG.japanese: 驚きだった。……霧江さまは戦人さんと交流を持てていたのだ。霧江さまが話すには、戦人さんと留弗夫さまの親子喧嘩はとっくに落ち着いているが、どちらも意地になってしまって、仲直りするタイミングを失っているのだという。また、戦人さんも祖父母宅とそちらの学校での新しい生活に馴染んでおり、また、厄介になっている祖父母の都合もあり、簡単によりを戻せないらしい。
MG.translation: I was surprised. ...So, Kyrie-sama was in touch with Battler-san. According to her, both Battler-san and Rudolf-sama had long since calmed down after their fight, but both were so stubborn that they hadn't found a good chance to make up. And, since Battler-san had gotten used to living with his grandparents and going to school there, and considering that those grandparents might make things even more difficult, going to convince Battler-san to come home wouldn't be easy.

UP.japanese: 驚きだった。……霧江さまは戦人さんと交流を持てていたのだ。霧江さまが話すには、戦人さんと留弗夫さまの親子喧嘩はとっくに落ち着いているが、どちらも意地になってしまって、仲直りするタイミングを失っているのだという。また、戦人さんも祖父母宅とそちらの学校での新しい生活に馴染んでおり、また、厄介になっている祖父母の都合もあり、簡単によりを戻せないらしい。
UP.translation: I was surprised. ......So, Kyrie‐sama was in touch with Battler‐san. According to her, the fight between Battler‐san and Rudolf‐sama had calmed down a long time ago, but both were so stubborn that they hadn't found a good chance to make up. And since Battler‐san had gotten used to living with his grandparents and going to school near there, it wasn't going to be easy to get him to come back home, especially considering that the grandparents were adding extra complications.

findings.sourceReading: Battler has adapted to life and school at the grandparents’ home, and the circumstances of the grandparents to whom he is indebted also make simply reuniting difficult.
findings.alternative: The next dialogue explicitly says Asumu’s parents were angrier and the quarrel now involves more people. That supports an obstacle connected to them, but does not specify their making things harder as the explanation of their tsugou, and going to convince Battler changes the reconciliation event into another party’s attempt.

UP.translation:
Beatrice hung her head in shame. If she hadn't encouraged Shannon so much, it probably wouldn't have been this painful. Shannon may have been the one to sow the seed of love in her heart.

findings.sourceReading: Beatrice identifies herself as the one who irresponsibly egged Shannon on to water the seed and not give up. Both water it and do not give up are the counsel she gave.
findings.alternative: Beatrice’s encouragement metaphorically nourished the love, and later she says she nurtured it. Here the imperatives explicitly characterize her role as urging Shannon, while the English makes watering her direct action and keeps only not giving up as advice.

MG.japanese:
彼は、どんな容姿の女性が好きか、話していたことがありましたね。……それは、外国のモデルのような、金髪で髪が長くて、スタイルの良い女性。金髪で。髪が長くて。スタイルが良くて。……そう。そんな感じ。

あぁ、我は我にして我等なり。目覚めなさい、我等たち。そして新しい世界に羽ばたきなさい……。
MG.translation: He did tell us what his ideal woman would look like once, remember? ...A woman with a good figure and long, golden hair, like a foreign model. Golden hair. Long hair. A good figure. ...Yeah. Something like that. That's what the new Beatrice will look like. Come now, hold that bud of love in your heart as you wait for Battler. ...This way, you will learn of love, in exchange for earning pain. Yes, this will be the setting for my new world. For Shannon, a new servant like a little brother will come. He will be a silent, reticent boy. A duty-minded kid who loves Shannon as a sister. And the bud of love that has tortured Shannon...will go to the witch, Beatrice. She will just be holding onto the bud of love for the time being. However, while she holds onto it, she will be a maiden in love with Battler. For that time, you will be able to learn what love is... Come, let the world be modified. Oh, I am one yet many. Awaken, us. And stretch your wings in this new world...

findings.sourceReading: Shannon feels as though she has properly put away a lovely precious item held in trust. Azukarimono specifies something entrusted to someone’s keeping.
findings.alternative: Putting something precious safely away conveys safekeeping, and the preceding transfer explicitly says the witch is only holding the bud. It nevertheless omits the entrusted status in this waking echo and adds the place it belongs as a substitute rationale.

でも、明るい表情だった。戦人さんのことが、……今も、好き。でも、もう、……何というか、………落ち着いた。素敵で大切な預かり物を、……ちゃんとしっかりと仕舞えたような、そんな気持ち。…………戦人さん。いつか、帰って来てくれるかな。
そしたら、また一緒に、ミステリー談義で盛り上がりたいな。……そうそう、いけない。
今日は新しい使用人の男の子が来るんだっけ。お館様直属の珍しい使用人。
一体、どんな子だろう。仲良くなれるといいな……。名前は何て言ったっけ。
確か、えぇと……。
MG.translation: My tear-stained face really is pathetic. However, my expression is bright and cheery. Even now, I... like Battler-san. But, ...for some reason, ...I've calmed down. It feels like I've put something precious safely away in the place it belongs. ......Battler-san. When will you come back, I wonder... When you do, I'd like to talk about mystery novels again. ...Oh, I almost forgot. A new boy servant will be coming today, right? One of the rare servants who will serve the Master directly. What kind of kid will he be? I hope we get along well... What was his name again? I'm pretty sure it was, umm...

UP.translation:
My tear‐stained face really looked pathetic.
However, my expression was bright and cheery. I still do... ...love... Battler‐san. But, ......I think I'd say... ......I've calmed down. It feels like I've put something precious safely away in the place it belongs. ............Battler‐san. When will you come back, I wonder...
When you do, I'd like to talk about mystery novels again. ......Oh, I almost forgot.
A new boy servant will be coming today, won't he? One of the rare servants who will serve the Master directly.
What kind of kid will he be? I hope we get along well...... What was his name again?
I think......it was......

findings.sourceReading: Shannon wonders whether he might return someday, then imagines what she would like to do if he does.
findings.alternative: Itsuka can contribute an indefinite future time, but itsuka kaette kite kureru kana questions whether that eventual return will happen. When will you come back presupposes it and shifts the uncertainty to timing. The surrounding calm does not require confidence in eventual return.

contexts.note: MG omits 帰って来ない彼 at435 and437: cannot stop waiting forever for someone who will not return. UP restores nonreturn at435 and its repetition437 is recoverable immediately. Strongest alternative: 431 says he does not intend returning, making bleakness inferable. Lack of intent is not narrator current absolute nonreturn, so minor rhetorical/emotional specificity loss in MG. One parent with recurrence437–438; UP contextual correction.

MG.japanese: 私の嗚咽に応えるように、胸の締め付けは一層に強まる。戦人さんを好きでいる限り、この痛みは永遠に続く。彼を好きだからこそ、この痛みを抱いて、いつまでも待ち続けたい。でも、……譲治さまたちの手紙に書いてあった。彼はもう、右代宮家に戻るつもりはないのだ。私のことも、六軒島のことも忘れてしまっていて、……右代宮でない姓を名乗って、新しい生活をしているのだ。私は、こんなにも苦しくて、痛くて、辛いまま、………永遠に、帰って来ない彼を、待ち続けなくてはならないのだ…。
MG.translation: As I sobbed, the tightness in my chest grew even stronger. As long as I like Battler-san, that pain will always continue. Because I like him, I want to hold onto that pain forever. But, ...it was written right there in the letters for George-sama and the others. Battler doesn't plan on returning to the Ushiromiya family. He's forgotten about me and Rokkenjima... and has started a new life with a different name. I must wait for him for all eternity, ...despite how painful, aching, excruciating this is...

UP.japanese: 私の嗚咽に応えるように、胸の締め付けは一層に強まる。戦人さんを好きでいる限り、この痛みは永遠に続く。彼を好きだからこそ、この痛みを抱いて、いつまでも待ち続けたい。でも、……譲治さまたちの手紙に書いてあった。彼はもう、右代宮家に戻るつもりはないのだ。私のことも、六軒島のことも忘れてしまっていて、……右代宮でない姓を名乗って、新しい生活をしているのだ。私は、こんなにも苦しくて、痛くて、辛いまま、………永遠に、帰って来ない彼を、待ち続けなくてはならないのだ…。
UP.translation: As I sobbed, the tightness in my chest grew even stronger. As long as I love Battler‐san, that pain will always continue. Because I love him, I want to hold onto that pain forever. But......it was written right there in the letters for George‐sama and the others. Battler doesn't plan on returning to the Ushiromiya family. He's forgotten about me and Rokkenjima, ......and has started a new life with a different name. I have to endure all this aching, biting, agonizing pain... ......and wait forever for someone who will never return...
